request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (for studies) expires on Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. The Ausländerbehörde has already booked you an appointment to apply for the extension.

**What to do before then**
- **Go to the appointment** on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. It is at Musterplatz 1, 2nd floor, Room 2.14.
- **Bring the originals:** passport, current enrolment certificate, proof of funds, proof of health insurance, a biometric photo, and your tenancy agreement or landlord confirmation.
- **Pay the fee** of 100.00 € on site [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. Pay by girocard, because cash is not possible.
- **If you can't attend,** cancel at least three working days beforehand. Ordnung shows a computed date of Fri 9 Oct 2026 for this deadline, and to post a cancellation by Mon 5 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- **Check your passport.** It expires on Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_cw9j6w5ppdvs], and Ordnung flags that date as needing a check. A permit usually runs only as long as the passport, so you may want to start renewing it soon.

**If you apply before the permit expires,** it usually counts as still valid until the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). You can ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung. The letter itself says the permit ends if you don't apply in time [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].

For residence matters, get advice if you are unsure.

Ihre Aufenthaltserlaubnis zum Zweck des Studiums nach § 16b Abs. 1 des Aufenthaltsgesetzes
